title: 사단령 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Establishment of Departments and Units)
(1) A division shall be composed of a division headquarters and the necessary combat units, combat support units, and combat service support units (hereinafter referred to as "establishment units").
(2) Matters concerning the establishment and division of duties of staff departments at division headquarters shall be prescribed by the Chief of Staff of the Army; and matters concerning the establishment, duties, and organization of establishment units shall be prescribed by the Minister of National Defense.
